rounds.question: Name a thing you do on Labor Day weekend.
rounds.notes: Bonus points: watch football, eat a tomato sandwich, wear white, stress about Christmas presents.

rounds.question: Your first thought when you see your ex across the bar?

answers.text: Fight response (Ew / hell no / they got ugly)

rounds.question: Something you've done that your parents still don't know about.
rounds.notes: Bonus points: public indecency, skydiving, sex (specifically gay).

answers.text: Minor in possession of alcohol or illegal substances
Crossing state or international borders for sex

rounds.question: Something that's overpriced but you buy anyway.
rounds.notes: Bonus points: frozen shrimp scampi, electrolytes, 3 ply toilet paper.

rounds.question: Something you pretend to understand but actually don't.
rounds.notes: Bonus points: Chess, Fashion, Offsides, Why Lindsey <3 Erling Haaland.

rounds.question: A place you go on a Saturday.
rounds.notes: Bonus points: if you said a unique hobby.

rounds.question: Where you met your best friend.
rounds.notes: Bonus point: whoever said the Zoo.

answers.text: At home (do you have a best friend?)

rounds.question: Least memorable US President.
rounds.notes: Lose one point for every person on your team who said “The ones I don't remember” or any derivative thereof.

answers.text: Any other president who got exactly one vote

rounds.question: Something you do in the car that you wouldn't do in public.
rounds.notes: Best answer: Pee in a Calypso Lemonade bottle. It burns.

answers.text: Nasty behavior (pick nose, clip nails/toes, scratch privates, pee in a bottle)

rounds.question: An app you'd be embarrassed to share your weekly screen time on.
rounds.glitchQuestion: Your worst personality trait, determined by the app you spend the most time on.
rounds.notes: Best answers: Google Maps (bless your heart), TMZ (the last true American).

answers.text: Negative attention span (TikTok, Instagram, Threads, Snap)
